thread:
maria (AE): Hey team — Petra Analytics wants a short POC to validate sustained 150 qps with a mixed workload (70% chat-gen, 30% embeddings) and tight p95 <= 120ms target. They care about burst behavior and encryption (KMS). Can we run a conservative load plan and an ops/pricing ask?

ton y (SE): Copy. Do we know model size they want to test?

maria (AE): They asked to use an open Llama-2 style variant we host (16B quant). Also asked for a fallback plan if latency spikes during bursts.

sam (SRE): For 150 qps sustained with mixed profile we should size a 4-GPU pool (A100x4 equiv) with autoscale to +1 node for bursts. Prefetch KV caching will help chat-gen tails.

jess (Perf Eng): Agree. Proposed load plan:

```
- Ramp: 0 -> 150 qps over 6 minutes
- Run: 30 minutes sustained at 150 qps
- Bursts: 3x 30s spikes to 300 qps, spaced 7 minutes apart
- Mix: 70% chat (prompt avg tokens 120, gen avg 80), 30% embedding (embed dim 1536)
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, GPU util, KV cache hit rate
```

sam (SRE): Will instrument heap/cold-start counters and tail sampling. We'll enable prefix caching and test with/without to show delta.

ryan (Pricing): Need to surface two numbers: hosted per-token estimate and a dedicated-monthly commitment for A100x4 with burst coverage. For quick quote: hosted estimate ~ $0.60/token-gen-equivalent for chat portion? That seems off — need perf numbers first.

maria (AE): Petra also emailed a security questionnaire — they require KMS integration (customer-managed), audit logs retention 1 year, and SOC2 mention. sec-bot, any red flags?

sec-bot: KMS customer-managed is supported in Private and Dedicated; hosted requires managed KMS but we can discuss a contract amendment. Audit logs 1 year is covered by enterprise add-on. SOC2 in progress — we have interim attestation.

jess (Perf Eng): For the runbook I'll prepare a short results template: p95 latency plot, spike timelines, cost calc per 100k tokens, and a short note on fallback (route to gpt-small variant running on more nodes with higher throughput but lower quality).

tony (SE): Ops notes: need vpc peering for Petra to push evaluation traffic, or we can run a proxy to collect telemetry. Also request Petra send a sample prompt set (1000 queries) and target token distribution.

maria (AE): I'll ask them for the prompt set and confirm timeline (they want results by end of next week). Also confirm they can accept a short NDA amendment for KMS/Private discussion.

ryan (Pricing): I'll draft two cost scenarios once jess posts the perf numbers: 1) Hosted best-effort pricing (pay-as-you-go + enterprise KMS uplift), 2) Dedicated reserved (monthly commit) with burst buffer + 99.9% availability SLA.

sam (SRE): I'll schedule the bench for Thursday 09:00 PT. Need confirmation on token mix and the sample prompts. Also flagging a potential blocker: if prompts include long-context (>2048 tokens) we need different memory config.

maria (AE): Petra confirmed avg context ~430 tokens, max rarely >1200. I'll push the sample now.

jess (Perf Eng): Great — I'll prepare two runs (cache on/off). Expected outcome: with caching p95 ~ 80–110ms, without ~150–220ms (est). Will log everything to the bench dashboard.

tony (SE): Ops checklist for Thursday run:
- pre-provision A100x4 pool
- enable KV cache + metrics
- set autoscale + burst policy (+1 node)
- enable encryption in transit and point to KMS test key
- provide Petra a secure ingress endpoint or VPC peering

maria (AE): Thanks all. Action items: I (maria) will get prompt set + NDA; sam will provision; jess will run and post results; ryan will prep cost scenarios. Follow-up in this thread after the bench. :thumbsup:
